label: output written before the run succeeds
replace: try write(try session.save(), to: target, replace: force || output == nil, io: io); let outcome = try session.run(dropped.steps.first ?? step)

label: an existing --out overwritten without --force
find: if output != nil { try refuseExisting([target], force: force, io: io) }

label: availability not checked before the run
find: if let why = session.availability(step.id).why { throw CatalogError.unavailable(id: step.id, why: why) }
